caption: Castel Sant'Angelo, Rome
composition: Tiber fortress and Ponte Sant'Angelo at dawn · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera stands on the far bank of the Tiber at dawn, facing Castel Sant'Angelo across the water. The great cylindrical fortress fills the left and center of the frame, its brick drum glowing amber in the low sun, while the Ponte Sant'Angelo with its row of angel statues stretches rightward across the river. The modelled 23 September 2026, 07:21 sky is pale and luminous behind the castle, and the dark water of the Tiber carries a soft reflection of the morning light.
